item.description:
Formula 0.1.51

  • Formula for Windows is published with every release (preview) (#74)
  • Updates: a new version waits for working agents to finish before it relaunches Formula (#77)
  • Agents can look up production logs and feature flags with no sign-in, and an idea's feature switch is a real GrowthBook flag you can turn on from Release (#78)
  • Releases: the public releases repo stops growing by 50 MB with every release (#76)
